frequency_question: How often do high-priority, high-magnitude executive regulatory initiatives pushed by committed principals get successfully finalized within a multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes major unilateral executive regulatory actions initiated and prioritized by the executive branch; excludes routine administrative updates or minor procedural rules.
window: Within a 3-year operating window of a presidential administration.

cases.name: 2018 Department of Homeland Security Public Charge Rule
2017 EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal and Replacement
2019 Department of Labor Overtime Rule Update
2020 HHS/Treasury ACA Section 1332 Waiver Transparency Rules

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major high-priority rules finalized by executive principals; baseline execution rate for prioritized regulatory intent is very high when evaluated purely through the lens of will and capability.
known_gaps: Does not account for external judicial blocks or procedural delays outside the pure will-and-capability frame.
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of the current executive administration's tenure.
